properties.description: Built 2026-10-21 (phase 7 PR 1). On a server that is not a registry (the --call door, stdio): upstream_status and loop_status read each xref into a pinned design against the record read on that pass — `link_far_end_stale` when an export read whole no longer holds the far node, `link_far_end_unreachable` when the record could not be read (missing, unreadable, unreachable, refused); review_relations and add_decision's related_to refuse, writing nothing, a link to a node the pinned design's committed export does not hold. An export that cannot be read does not block the draw. A design pinned at an address is checked only for reachability (its fingerprint carries no node list). Reading the far node's TRUTH from an export (a far premise) is not built. Core: depends.rs ObservedUpstream.node_ids and the link loop; MCP: upstream.rs observe_one, far_nodes_not_in_their_export, tools/capture.rs, tools/coherence.rs.
properties.name: A link into a design pinned by its export reads stale when the far node is gone and unreachable when the export cannot be read, and is checked when drawn
